prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: premium editorial illustration for the physics hero and subject cover of a German school learning website.
Primary request: a beautiful tactile, physically plausible miniature electromagnet apparatus, a continuous copper-wire solenoid wound densely and evenly around a dark matte iron cylinder, held horizontally by two understated pale ceramic supports on a warm ivory tabletop. The coil axis runs mostly left to right, seen in elegant three-quarter perspective. The iron cylinder extends visibly a little beyond both ends.
Style/medium: exceptionally refined 3D editorial product illustration with photographic material detail, finely brushed copper, subtle insulation sheen, matte ceramic, soft ambient occlusion and natural diffuse daylight. Calm intelligent schoolbook, no toy plastic look, no flat vector icon aesthetic.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, apparatus centered and fully visible, generous clean space on all sides suitable for responsive cropping; object fills about two thirds of the image. A tiny portion of graph paper beneath the apparatus may ground the learning context, with no text.
Color palette: warm cream background matching #f8f8f2, forest green and muted sage accents, warm copper wire, graphite iron.
Constraints: depict one continuous plausible coil; no floating disconnected loops; no letters, numerals, formula, annotations, logos, watermark, lightning, neon effects or decorative pseudo-scientific field lines. This is an illustrative apparatus cover; exact field arrows will be added separately in the interactive website.
